prohibited: Compute or inspect rate/trait/genotype response values
Use sampled species range to fill missing original population coordinates

source_geometry_rules.species_id: Use normalized published binomial sp_pub when valid; fallback sp_ncbi only if independently plausible binomial, report ambiguity and no fuzzy name matching.
source_geometry_rules.study_id: Original ref_ID as published; do not equate effect records with independent studies.
source_geometry_rules.taxonomic_genus: First token of valid binomial, not split on underscore count without normalizing underscores.
source_geometry_rules.numeric_years_and_generation_metadata: Only counts of presence/validity; do not summarize historical genetic or phenotypic rates.
source_geometry_rules.environmental_labels: Report source-defined system, phylum, experimental, exp_type, genphen, design and trait_type code counts as source-only non-outcome metadata; no biological interpretation of undefined codes.

prospective_gate.report_first: All-source and terrestrial preliminary counts, both-endpoint coordinates vs any-endpoint counts, study/genus/split counts and missingness by design label.
prospective_gate.if_pass: SOURCE_GEOMETRY_POSSIBLE_NOT_FIT_AUTHORIZATION; require independent codebook and effect-size estimation specification before opening phenotype rates
